methods.name: Apply
methods.description:
Create or update a session.
 The authorization and state-operation are determined depending on whether the session
 is going to be created or updated which is determined as part of the request execution.

methods.name: Create
methods.description:
Create a new session for an agent.
 Requires can_create_session permission in the organization.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Update an existing session (e.g., subject, thread_id, sandbox_id).

methods.name: UpdateSubject
methods.description:
Set the session subject.

 This is a targeted update that modifies only the subject field,
 leaving other session fields untouched. Use this instead of the full
 update RPC when you only need to change the session subject.

 @internal
 Server-side field-level update, race-safe. Atomically modifies only
 spec.subject without touching other fields. Eliminates the lost-update
 race between GenerateSessionSubject and sandbox_manager, which both run
 in parallel during agent execution.

methods.name: UpdateSandboxId
methods.description:
Set the session sandbox ID.

 This is a targeted update that modifies only the sandbox ID field,
 leaving other session fields untouched. Use this instead of the full
 update RPC when you only need to change the sandbox assignment.

 @internal
 Server-side field-level update, race-safe. Atomically modifies only
 spec.sandbox_id without touching other fields. Eliminates the lost-update
 race between sandbox_manager and GenerateSessionSubject, which both run
 in parallel during agent execution.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Delete a session (also cleans up thread and sandbox).

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Get a single session by ID.

methodTypes.name: UpdateSessionSubjectRequest
methodTypes.description:
UpdateSessionSubjectRequest sets the conversation title for a session.

 This is a field-level update that atomically modifies only the subject
 field, avoiding the lost-update race condition that occurs when multiple
 activities (e.g., GenerateSessionSubject and sandbox_manager) concurrently
 perform full-resource updates on the same session.

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: New subject value. Empty string clears the subject.

methodTypes.name: UpdateSessionSandboxIdRequest
methodTypes.description:
UpdateSessionSandboxIdRequest sets the Daytona sandbox ID for a session.

 This is a field-level update that atomically modifies only the sandbox_id
 field, avoiding the lost-update race condition that occurs when multiple
 activities concurrently perform full-resource updates on the same session.
